habits.boundary_condition: Treat business class as preferred rather than mandatory, and compare the fare against the stated budget
habits.condition: When selecting a flight and the premium fare fits the trip budget
habits.exception_condition: Fall back to economy when business class exceeds the budget; consider first class only when its price is acceptable
habits.name: budget-conditioned business-class preference
habits.rationale: Across three independent flight requests, the user selects or initially requests business class, explicitly ties an upgrade to affordability, and accepts economy when business class is too expensive.

source_evidence.contribution: Establishes business class as the requested cabin, with subsequent turns making higher-cabin options conditional on price.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: I would like the business class.

source_evidence.contribution: Directly supports choosing business class when the upgrade remains within budget.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: Okay. What if I upgraded to business class. Could I do that within my budget?

source_evidence.contribution: Supports economy as the fallback after the requested business-class fare was shown to exceed the budget.
